name: Dreamer's Rock
summary: At Dreamer's Rock, Naralex sleeps while the Barrens still wait for renewal. He came to restore the land through the Emerald Dream, but his communion now feeds a nightmare.

sections.title: The Slumber of Naralex
sections.body: At the heart of the Wailing Caverns, Naralex lies in a chamber like a night elf barrow den. He entered a deep trance to reach the underground springs and channel the Emerald Dream into the Barrens' dry soil. Dark forces seized that connection, and his nightmare now twists the chamber's wildlife. His followers became the venomous Druids of the Fang, and terrible aberrations spill into the waking world.

sections.title: The Awakening Ritual
sections.body: A surviving Disciple of Naralex can reach Dreamer's Rock and perform the waking ritual once the corruption of the Fanglords ends. As the chant begins, Naralex's lingering nightmare sends monstrosities to guard its hold on his sleeping mind. Mutanus the Devourer is the final horror of this psychic torment. The aberration rises from the depths of the dreamer's subconscious to consume those who seek to free him.

faq.q: Who is sleeping at Dreamer's Rock?
faq.answer: Naralex, a night elf druid, sleeps at Dreamer's Rock. He came to the Wailing Caverns to use its underground water channels to restore life to the Barrens, but nightmares seized his communion with the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: Why is this chamber called Dreamer's Rock?
faq.answer: The chamber takes its name from Naralex, known as 'the Dreamer.' Like a night elf barrow den, it holds his resting body while his spirit travels through the Dream.

faq.q: What happens when you try to wake Naralex?
faq.answer: After the Fanglords are defeated, a surviving Disciple of Naralex attempts the waking ritual. The ritual brings horrors from Naralex's nightmare to guard his sleeping mind.

faq.q: Why did Naralex's followers turn hostile?
faq.answer: Naralex's nightmare warped his followers' minds. They abandoned their Cenarion vows, embraced serpent aspects, and became the Druids of the Fang, guarding their master's tormented, unending sleep.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see the danger in Naralex's attempt to reach the Emerald Dream. Noble intent can meet horrors that slumber within.
As a night elf, you find a sacred barrow-style chamber corrupted beneath the arid Barrens. Naralex and his followers took tragic risks far from Kalimdor's northern forests.
